title: Ali Pay Zulm Ki Jo
body:
Ali Pay Zulm ki Jo Hoti Inteyha Dekhi
Har ek Beti ki roti Howi Rida Dekhi
<<DIVIDER>>
1- Jo Kul e Eema o Wajhay Khuda pay Zarab chali
Too Rooti Kufay may Tafaseer E La illaah Dekhi
<<DIVIDER>>
2- Rida ko bhool kay Zainab ko Ghush pay Ghush Aaey
Lahoo say Surkh Joun hi Shakal e Murtaza Dekhi
<<DIVIDER>>
3- Hussain Amma meri Amma keh kay Doorh Paaray
Sirhanay Baap kay jo Amma Fatima Dekhi
<<DIVIDER>>
4- Galay Hussain ko Mola nay Lagaya Shaiyad
Lahoo may Doobi howi Arzay Karbala Dekhi
<<DIVIDER>>
5- Kuch esa kar kay dekhana hai bolay Ghazi say
Zamana bolay na easi kabhi wafa Dekhi
<<DIVIDER>>
6- Qalum bhi cheekha Salamat ka Haraf ronay lagay
Jo Maah e Ramzaa may Karbal ki ibtayda Dekhi
